create_clvp_encoder_config: create a ClvpEncoderConfig with custom hidden_size, num_hidden_layers, and vocab_size parameters
create_clvp_decoder_config: create a ClvpDecoderConfig with custom hidden_size, num_hidden_layers, and max_text_tokens parameters
create_clvp_config: create a ClvpConfig combining ClvpEncoderConfig for text and speech with ClvpDecoderConfig
load_clvp_encoder_from_pretrained: load a ClvpEncoderConfig from a pretrained model checkpoint with text_config or speech_config type
initialize_clvp_model: initialize a ClvpConfig with default sub-configs for text, speech, and decoder components
